'''Transport eight''' was a [[TR-286 transport|TR-286]]<ref name="2024 Encyclopedia" /> automated transport that was based at a [[Daiyu cargo port|cargo port]] on [[Daiyu]]. It was used to secretly ferry [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] from Daiyu to [[Mapuzo]].<ref name="Part III" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Transport eight was first pictured in the official trailer for the [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] television series, which was released on [[May 4]], [[2022]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|3Yh_6_zItPU|Obi-Wan Kenobi | Official Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/official-trailer-obi-wan-kenobi}}</ref> It first appeared in the [[Part II|second episode]] of the series,<ref name="Part III" /> which was released on [[May 26]], 2022.<ref name="Episode 2 Premiere">{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}}</ref>

In the series' script, the ship was described as an automated [[transport]], so propmaster [[Brad Elliott]] decided it was illogical to have a launch key designed for [[human]]s. The team decided to use a rigged [[scomp link]] [[computer]] interface device that had its own circuit board to simulate what an [[astromech droid]] would use to start the transport's launch sequence and program the route.<ref name="Brewing rebellion">{{SW|url=news/inside-the-lucasfilm-archive-obi-wan-kenobi-props-3|text=Inside the Lucasfilm Archive: A Brewing Rebellion in the ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' Limited Series}}</ref>
